bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
SVC=deploy-gaybbs-1
TAG=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
NEW=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
OLD=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-search-colors-20261114
label="$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
file="${label%%,*}"
test -f "$file"
test "$(docker compose -f "$file" -p deploy config --hash gaybbs | grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{64}' | head -1)" = "$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}')" || exit 61
before="$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{.Image}}')"
test "$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker image inspect "$TAG" --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$before" || exit 63
newid="$(docker image inspect "$NEW" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 64
if [ "$before" = "$newid" ]; then exit 0; fi
docker tag "$before" "$OLD"
docker tag "$NEW" "$TAG"
restore(){
 docker tag "$OLD" "$TAG" || true
 docker compose -f "$file" -p deploy up -d --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
if ! docker compose -f "$file" -p deploy up -d --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 restore
 exit 71
fi
sleep 6
if [ "$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{.Image}}')" != "$newid" ] || [ "$(docker inspect "$SVC" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" != true ]; then
 restore
 exit 72
fi
exit 0
